title: Garnet considers your offer

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: So, uh... you talked to Mila, huh?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, uh... you talked to Mila, huh?
I did.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Look, the kid means well. And... she's very strong-willed. She's really pushing me out of my comfort zone, whether I like it or not.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Look, the kid means well. And... she's very strong-willed. She's really pushing me out of my comfort zone, whether I like it or not.
She's worried about you.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Yeah, her heart is in the right place, but I really don't need any more friends, or partners, or... anyone really. Just me and her. Every night I'm not dreaming of more friends. I'm dreaming of pizza that has real cheese. Imagine that!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yeah, her heart is in the right place, but I really don't need any more friends, or partners, or... anyone really. Just me and her. Every night I'm not dreaming of more friends. I'm dreaming of pizza that has real cheese. Imagine that!
Imagine.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: So what happened with Mila? I assume you "passed" your interview?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So what happened with Mila? I assume you "passed" your interview?
I did, and I'm glad.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Hey, snap! Thanks for being honest with me though.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, snap! Thanks for being honest with me though.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: No offense, I'm just not really interested.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No offense, I'm just not really interested.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: No offense, I'm just not really interested.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: No offense, I'm just not really interested.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Hey, I get it. Let's just leave it there then. Have a good day.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Hey, I get it. Let's just leave it there then. Have a good day.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Right. Uh, great. I mean... good. So I guess we could grab a drink or a bite some time.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Right. Uh, great. I mean... good. So I guess we could grab a drink or a bite some time.
Sure.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Say, do you want to hear a joke? I heard my old landlord Pilk Dane tell this one, but he butchered the punchline. Wanna hear my version?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Say, do you want to hear a joke? I heard my old landlord Pilk Dane tell this one, but he butchered the punchline. Wanna hear my version?
Sure!

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I did, but I don't need a friend or partner.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I did, but I don't need a friend or partner.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I did, but I don't need a friend or partner.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I did, but I don't need a friend or partner.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: What do you call a thousand CorpSec Officers at the bottom of the ocean?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What do you call a thousand CorpSec Officers at the bottom of the ocean?
A good start?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Oh what? I love this! Hahaha! I love you for this!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh what? I love this! Hahaha! I love you for this!
You...?

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: Let's... uh... let's chat again. This was fun. Really.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Let's... uh... let's chat again. This was fun. Really.
Sure.

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: If you see Mila, tell her... Tell her I'll be home late. Long shift tonight. And tell her... she's a good interviewer. And a good kid.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: If you see Mila, tell her... Tell her I'll be home late. Long shift tonight. And tell her... she's a good interviewer. And a good kid.
Sure Garnet.
She's interfering in your life.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: It's nothing business. It's just personal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It's nothing business. It's just personal.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: It's nothing business. It's just personal.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: It's nothing business. It's just personal.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: ...Sure.
A cost-effective streamlining exercise.
HAHA, BLUB BLUB motherfuckers!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: I was gonna say "a good start", but your punchline is good too!

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I was gonna say "a good start", but your punchline is good too!

nodes.speaker: Garnet
nodes.text: That was it! Haha, nice one.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: That was it! Haha, nice one.
They're both good.
Thanks.
Yum.
